attributes.title: Shop Signboard Measurement
attributes.description: A Computer Vision system designed to identify and measure commercial shop signboards from images captured by shop owners. The system detects the signboard, determines its dimensions, and calculates its area, enabling local authorities to accurately assess sign sizes for regulatory purposes, fee calculations, and enforcement.

attributes.title: Document Intelligence
attributes.description: A Computer Vision and OCR system designed to extract structured information from Egyptian national ID card images. The system identifies the document, detects key data regions, extracts relevant information, and converts the extracted content into structured data suitable for integration with digital systems and applications.

attributes.title: Exam Cheating Detection
attributes.description: A Computer Vision system designed to monitor students during examinations in college computer laboratories. The system analyzes eye movement and visual behavior to detect potentially suspicious activity. When suspicious behavior is identified, the system alerts the responsible supervisor, who can choose to warn the student or automatically lock the student's device.

attributes.title: AI-Powered Smart Water Management
attributes.description: An AI-powered smart water management system designed to detect, analyze, and locate water leaks across water networks. The system analyzes network parameters such as flow rates and pressure levels to identify abnormal patterns, estimate leak severity, and determine potential leak locations. When a leak is detected, the system notifies responsible engineers, enabling rapid intervention. The system also includes a mobile application for engineers and citizens to facilitate communication, issue reporting, leak monitoring, and real-time status tracking.

attributes.title: Intelligent Document Validation
attributes.description: An AI-powered system for validating HR and official documents. The system identifies document types, detects and extracts key information, and verifies multiple elements including stamps, document data, and information consistency. It combines Computer Vision, OCR, and specialized validation models to generate a validation result and provide reasons for any detected issues.

attributes.title: AI-Powered Assistive Communication Devices
attributes.description: An AI-powered assistive communication system designed to facilitate interaction between deaf or hard-of-hearing individuals and blind or visually impaired individuals. The system consists of two integrated smart devices: AI-powered smart glasses and a smartwatch. It uses Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, NLP, LLMs, and Speech Recognition to translate and convert information across different communication modalities, enabling more accessible communication between users.
